thread:
anika_pm: Heads-up: I want a short decision here on 'litmus cohort' gating for catalog entries + a repeatable deprecation cadence. Customer asks keep coming (esp. regulatory customers). Can we agree on a simple, dev-friendly policy?

diego_eng: TL;DR: one canonical litmus per bench_profile + a tiny per-customer cohort for 72h before full pin. Keeps signal tight and cheap.

tara_sre: Agree on cohort idea. Key SRE asks: 1) automatic eviction on threshold breach, 2) short-term 'soft-pin' that lets us auto-fallback for regressions, 3) extra traces during cohort.

anika_pm: Can you be explicit about "threshold breach"? Customers want numbers.

diego_eng: Proposal: two gates (signal & cost). Signal gate = rolling 3h p95 increase >12ms OR error rate +0.75%. Cost gate = token_cost delta >7%. Either -> evict.

kevin_se: From Sales: add a "calendar lock" option for enterprise customers (freeze upgrades during agreed windows). Also request: "pin escrow" 12h rollback guarantee for paid pins.

tara_sre: We can commit to a 12h emergency rollback SLA if customer pays for pin escrow. Non-escrow pins get a 72h notice window before forced migration.

lily_comm: Comms note: let's standardize the message to customers: "litmus cohort" = short pilot that may be auto-rolled back on regressions. Add link to FAQ + opt-in checkbox.

anika_pm: What about deprecation cadence? We need predictable timelines for customers and sales.

diego_eng: Suggest: three-phase deprecation: notice -> soft-retire -> hard-retire. Timelines depend on change_class. Example: patch: 7d notice -> soft-retire 14d -> hard-retire 30d. Minor: 14d -> 30d -> 60d. Major: 30d -> 60d -> 90d.

kevin_se: Legal will push for longer windows for enterprise. We should make bounds configurable per contract. Also surface deprecation window in the customer console.

tara_sre: Operationally, soft-retire = stop new pins, continue serving existing requests but route a safety-proxy variant for high-risk tokens. Hard-retire = block and return 410 with migration guidance.

anika_pm: Safety-proxy? explain.

diego_eng: Safety-proxy = lightweight shim that maps calls to a compatible older model + adds a compatibility header. Cheap and buy time for customers to migrate.

lily_comm: Marketing: name ideas: "compat adapter" or "compat shim". Keep it simple.

anika_pm: Good. I want a concrete config snippet to use in RFC + console UI fields. Diego?

diego_eng: Draft config (will refine in RFC):
```yaml
catalog_entry:
  name: fast-llama-3
  version: 1.2.0
  change_class: minor
  bench_profile: latency-v3
  litmus:
    cohort_size: 5 # number of customer tenants
    cohort_duration: 72h
    gates:
      latency_p95_ms: 12
      error_rate_pct: 0.75
      cost_pct: 7
  pin_policy:
    type: soft-pin
    escrow_window_hours: 12
    auto_fallback: true
  deprecation:
    notice_days: 14
    soft_retire_days: 30
    hard_retire_days: 60
```

anika_pm: Nice. A couple of asks: 1) surface bench failures per-region, 2) make cohort selection deterministic (hash-based on tenant id) and exposed in logs.

tara_sre: We'll add per-region bench results and deterministic cohort hashing. Also: post-deploy 48h retention bump for traces and kv cache logs for cohorts.

kevin_se: Sales: include a "migration assistance" tickbox in console for enterprise so SEs can request an assisted migration with a playbook.

lily_comm: I'll draft the customer-facing explainer and a short FAQ. Key Qs: what pin means, what compat shim does, how to opt-out.

anika_pm: Action items: @diego_eng RFC w/ config + selection algorithm, bench matrix per-region, console fields. @tara_sre ops runbook + rollback commands. @lily_comm customer FAQ + templated emails. @kevin_se collect legal/contract constraints. Review Wed 30m.

deploy-bot: New RFC created: rfc/1749999000-litmus-cohort-onboard (link: https://redwood.in/rfc/1749999000)

diego_eng: I'll add a short checklist in RFC: cohort seed algorithm, bench-sample sizes, telemetry retention bump, and a 'compat shim' implementation note.

anika_pm: If everyone's aligned I'll lock the RFC by EOD Fri. :white_check_mark:

kevin_se: Aligned from Sales.

lily_comm: Comms aligned, will send draft by Tue.

tara_sre: SRE ack. Will draft runbook skeleton after RFC.

anika_pm: Closing thread 10: see RFC link for details.
